decisive_spans.text: 4-mm punch biopsy from right arm showed superficial and deep perivascular and interstitial inflammation with numerous eosinophils
A recent trial of oral terbinafine yielded no improvement

response.rationale: D3 is supported by the presence of eosinophils on biopsy and the failure of terbinafine, suggesting a drug-induced etiology. D2 is also strongly supported by the biopsy findings but does not explicitly include the drug-induced aspect, which is suggested by the clinical context and the failure of antifungal treatment.
